settings.title: Workflow settings
settings.intro: Time limits, stage names, conciliation and complaint categories.
settings.categoriesHint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores, e.g. withheld_funds.
settings.aiHint: When off, nothing is sent to any AI provider and staff triage manually. Personal details are always removed before text is sent.

routing.title: Routing rules
routing.intro: Decide which officers receive new cases.
routing.explain: New cases go to the first matching rule (lowest position), to whichever officer in its list has the fewest open cases. Empty fields match anything. If no rule matches, the least-busy officer overall gets the case.
routing.none: No rules yet: cases go to the least-busy officer.
